blocks.text: The Cleanup Activity page allows you to view inactive Cloud Connector groups that are scheduled for deletion.
Cleanup Activity is in Limited Availability (LA). To enable this feature, contact Zscaler Support.
Cleanup activity provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: Manage the cleanup frequency of Cloud Connector groups.
View Cloud Connector groups that have been deleted automatically or manually.

blocks.text: On the Cleanup Activity page (Zero Trust Cloud > Cloud Connector > Cloud Connector Groups > Cleanup Activity), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Filter the list of groups by the following statuses:
Scheduled: The Cloud Connector group is scheduled to be deleted.
Delete failed: The Cloud Connector group failed to be deleted.
Deleted: The Cloud Connector group was successfully deleted.
Modify the table and its columns.
Name: The name of the Cloud Connector group.
Cloud: The cloud provider (i.e., Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP)).
Region: The region where the Cloud Connector group is deployed.
Status: The status of the scheduled deletion for the Cloud Connector group (i.e., Scheduled, Delete failed, or Deleted).
Schedule Delete Date: The date and time when the Cloud Connector group is scheduled to be deleted.
Delete by: The user or system who deleted the Cloud Connector group.
Go to the Upgrade Manager page.
